results.question: Q3236
results.result: The actual infimum sum quasinorm of two rearrangement-invariant Fatou quasi-Banach function spaces is rearrangement invariant and has the exact Fatou property.
results.scope: Sigma-finite resonant measure spaces, including nonatomic spaces and completely atomic spaces with equal atom masses.
results.verification: Complete analytical argument plus exact checks of an auxiliary non-attainment example.
results.remaining_gap: No gap identified by the separate internal AI review. External mathematical review and historical-priority assessment remain outstanding.

results.question: Q3454
results.result: If the corresponding source projections commute and the corresponding range projections commute, then M||a-b||<1 forces equality of supports and ||b^dagger-a^dagger||<=||b^dagger||||a^dagger||||a-b||.
results.scope: Any complex unital Banach algebra with norm-one unit, subject to the stated two pairwise commutation relations; M=max(||a^dagger||,||b^dagger||).
results.verification: Direct normed-algebra proof; six exact rational matrix examples and one sharp-threshold scalar example.
results.remaining_gap: The unrestricted noncommuting-support conjecture remains unresolved; strict separation of global algebra classes is not asserted.
